liveCounter.use: Running total that ticks for the whole video ("borrowed since you hit play").
liveCounter.formula: value = floor(shown * ratePerSecond / 30); ratePerSecond = 77105.04 (=2570.168 per frame)
liveCounter.colorFlash: turns red while the narration says the key verb (f69-87), back to ink after

flyToCorner.scale: 1.0 -> 0.3, ease-out; slight pre-scale to 1.05 at f133
flyToCorner.tag: white torn-paper tag x 1470-1861, y 15-122 grows in behind from f138 with tiny label over the value

yearFlip.chip: rough-edged black paper rectangle, white Anton digits, ~475x245 centred at (958, 592); tiny 'BY' typewriter above
yearFlip.behaviour: steps through years with ease-out spacing; each step shows one frame with a horizontal split line and slightly wider flap edges

stamp.look: red outlined box with red distressed caps, rotated -10°, multiply-ish opacity 0.9
stamp.opacity: starts 0.35 at f691, full by f694

badge.look: red filled circle ~70 px, white Anton '#1'

cornerDock.rule: The key number of a beat docks to a corner as a small persistent tag (debt counter -> top-right, 2048 chip -> top-left).
cornerDock.move: ease-in-out ~10 frames, scale to 0.3-0.35, never rotates
